stations.title: Rune
stations.say: Yusra's note lost half its words.

stations.title: Staff board
stations.text: Every open order as a card.

captions: Next, Rune finds that a customer's note lost half its words on the staff board.
The browser read part of the note as a tag, so those words never showed.
You catch the bad note, write customers' words as text and write the test, in three tasks.
Now the board shows every title, name and note exactly as it was typed.
Same order, same board. Nothing a customer types can become part of the page.
